_comment: THE SHOP'S CATALOGUE. Edit this file to change products, sizes, prices and partners; restart the server to apply.
Every price is a PLACEHOLDER until 'placeholderPrices' is set to false (the shop shows a 'test prices' banner and the server refuses live Stripe keys while it is true).
Prices are in major units (349.90 = R$ 349,90) and include VAT/taxes as shown to the customer. 'shipping' adds a flat amount per order; 0 = shipping included.

Where the placeholders come from (docs/research, seen 2026-11-10): digital migration maps on Etsy sell for BRL 32-98; framed migration prints BRL 240-1,198; the plan's framed hypothesis was USD 129-249. Partner wholesale costs are unknown until a Prodigi quote / local lab quote.

Prodigi SKUs: GLOBAL-HPR-A3 and GLOBAL-HPR-A2 (Hahnemuhle Photo Rag 308 gsm) were seen on Prodigi's product pages. GLOBAL-HPR-A1 and the framed GLOBAL-CFPM-A3/-A2 are UNVERIFIED guesses: check them with the Prodigi catalogue API or dashboard before going live.

UNVERIFIED (guessed 2026-11-17, never seen on Prodigi): the poster SKUs GLOBAL-EMA-A3/-A2/-A1 (Enhanced Matte Art paper, 200 gsm) and the canvas SKUs GLOBAL-CAN-A3/-A2 (stretched canvas) and its 'wrap' attribute value 'MirrorWrap' (mirrored edges, so the whole design stays on the front). Check each one before the first order.

'partnerAttributes' are fixed options sent to the partner with every order of that product (the canvas edge). Gift cards ('kind': 'giftcard') have value tiers V1-V3 instead of sizes; their 'prices' are the card's value in each currency, and they are never shipped.

Product names, descriptions and materials need 'pt', 'en' and 'es' (the site's languages); the shop shows the visitor's. Frame colours stay as English ids (sent to the partner); the pages translate them.

Each market's 'fulfilment' picks who makes physical products: 'prodigi' (API) or 'manual' (an operator sends the file to a local lab and framer). Brazil is manual: no Brazilian framed-print partner with an API was found.
